meta.title: Privacy policy | Patent Insurance Strategy
meta.description: How this website collects, uses and protects personal data under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.

header.title: Protecting your data
header.lead:
In line with Decree 13/2023/ND-CP
on personal data protection.

sections.title: Data we collect
items: Self-assessment: only your choices and score, no names, emails or IP addresses.
Interest form: organisation, contact person, email, type, field, topics and the message you provide.

sections.title: Purpose
items: Contacting you about the research and the proposed patent insurance pilot.
Compiling anonymous statistics for academic research.

sections.title: Sharing and retention
items: We never sell or share data with third parties for commercial purposes.
Data is kept until the research ends or until you ask us to delete it.

sections.title: Your rights
items: To know, access, correct or request deletion of your data.
To withdraw consent at any time.

sections.title: Data controller
items: Vu Thi Hong Ha, LL.B., author of the research, Hanoi Law University.
